subject: [PATCH v3 1/2] lib/zstd: add fallback aliases for disabled BMI2 variants

2026-09-01.patch_summary: This patch adds fallback aliases for disabled BMI2 variants in the Zstandard library. When dynamic BMI2 dispatch is disabled, the compiler must still parse and resolve function references that are conditionally compiled out. To avoid this issue, the patch introduces aliases from unavailable BMI2 function names to their default implementations. This allows the code to compile without emitting BMI2-specific code, even when BMI2 dispatch is disabled.
